stem: In a sepsis work-up for an infant aged 21 days corrected, which investigation is optional depending on the clinical context rather than routine for every infant in this age group?
explanation: Chest X-ray (CXR) is the optional investigation in this age group. The septic work-up includes routine tests such as CRP, blood culture, urine culture, and lumbar puncture, with CXR added only when clinically indicated.

rationale: The pathway lists CXR as the context-dependent component of the neonatal septic work-up, whereas the other investigations are routine.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because CRP is included routinely in the septic work-up.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because blood culture is included routinely in the septic work-up.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because CXR is marked as optional and is only performed when clinically indicated.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because lumbar puncture is part of the routine septic work-up in this age group.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because urine culture is included routinely in the septic work-up.
